reserveReview.rationale: Accessed 2026-09-30: the API still reports source updatedAt 2026-09-18T12:06:10.121Z, not the access time. Named USTB and BUIDL positions are $71.501 million and $4.806 million; total equity is $76.3091221907 million. Weights use named values divided by total equity and retain the $2,122.1907 residual, rather than renormalizing rounded positions. These are issuer-reported fund holdings, not independent examination. NC-113 remains blocked on source freshness: both exact keyed fund identities already exist, and the September 18 source is outside the dashboard admission window. Next evidence: a newly dated reconciled portfolio disclosure or independent same-checkpoint holdings and fund NAV capture. Neither a new review timestamp nor a duplicate manual dependency makes the live source current.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The July 17, 2026 mTBILL final terms name Maerki Baumann & Co. AG as custodian and Ankura Trust Company LLC as security agent, with custody and collateral accounts and agreements applicable. Provider shares, the custody mapping of the issuer-reported USTB/BUIDL wallets, and rehypothecation terms remain unresolved. The inherited segregated status is not newly confirmed by those terms; the custody and collateral agreements themselves are needed to renew that claim. Security arrangements do not confer direct ownership of underlying assets; the 2026 prospectus retains qualified subordination, limited recourse, and enforcement-risk warnings.
